about: The extensions the player offers ready to use (Extensions > Ready to add). Each entry is the address of an extension's manifest.json; "default": true installs it for everyone on first run. Viewers can remove any of them, and add others by address. Built in without an extension (see providers.js / resolve.js): YTS, EZTV and The Pirate Bay for sources; YIFY Subtitles and (with SUBDL_API_KEY) SubDL for subtitles; plus translation.
